name: My First Health Bot
tagline: A starter health coach for young adults living on their own
description: Made for people newly handling their own health, it suggests simple workouts and low-cost meal ideas, helps you find a local doctor or dentist, and keeps prescription refills from slipping. It also unpacks insurance basics in plain terms, and it says up front that it is not a doctor and does not diagnose anything.
author: gilman_trevor
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
